name: @ezacto/web
description: Responsive ezacto web application and theme runtime.

scripts.typecheck: npm run theme:check && npm run shell:generate && tsc --noEmit
scripts.browser:prepare: npm run build -w @ezacto/core && npm run build -w @ezacto/db && npm run build -w @ezacto/api && npm run build -w @ezacto/client && npm run build -w @ezacto/mailer && npm run build -w @ezacto/web
scripts.test:browser: npm run browser:prepare && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run theme:check && npm run shell:generate && vitest run && npm run test:browser
scripts.build: npm run theme:check && npm run shell:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
